catalog.name: Catalog record identifiers
catalog.approach_a: Sequential integer identifiers (auto-increment counter, rendered as decimal strings)

eventbus.name: In-process event bus
eventbus.approach_a: Synchronous dispatch: handlers run immediately inside publish()
eventbus.approach_b: Queued dispatch: publish() enqueues; handlers run in FIFO order during flush()

expr.name: Arithmetic expression evaluator
expr.approach_a: Recursive descent: one recursive function per grammar level (or precedence climbing)
expr.approach_b: Shunting-yard: table-driven operator precedence with explicit operator/output stacks (RPN)

graph.name: Undirected graph library
graph.approach_a: Adjacency lists/sets: mapping from node to the set of its neighbours
graph.approach_b: Adjacency matrix: an n x n boolean matrix indexed by node index

kvstore.name: Key-value store persistence
kvstore.approach_a: JSON document file (whole store loaded/saved as one JSON file)

ledger.name: Account ledger state management
ledger.approach_a: Event-sourced (append-only log of operations; balances derived from the log)
ledger.approach_b: Snapshot state (current balances stored and mutated directly; no operation log)

ratelimit.name: Per-key rate limiter
ratelimit.approach_a: Token bucket: per-key token count + last refill time; continuous refill
ratelimit.approach_b: Sliding window log: per-key list of request timestamps within the window

renderers.name: Report renderers
renderers.approach_a: Inheritance: abstract Renderer base class with a subclass per format (template method)
renderers.approach_b: Composition: plain renderer functions/strategies registered in a registry, shared helpers composed

undo.name: Text buffer undo/redo
undo.approach_a: Command pattern: each edit is a command object with execute/undo (inverse operation)
undo.approach_b: Memento: snapshot the full buffer text before each edit; undo restores the snapshot

wire.name: Sensor record wire format
wire.approach_a: Compact fixed-width binary records (struct-packed) with a small header
wire.approach_b: Newline-delimited JSON text (one JSON object per line)
